description: This file defines a service for listening to Android notifications, managing notification data, and enabling actions such as opening, dismissing, or replying to notifications within the app. It includes data classes for notification entries and snapshots, as well as mechanisms for handling notification events, permissions, and external communication.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual notification with relevant details such as key, package, title, text, category, tags, posting time, and status flags.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates the current state of notifications, including whether notifications are enabled, the connection status, and a list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Specifies a user's requested action on a notification, such as open, dismiss, or reply, along with optional reply text.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Returns the outcome of a notification action, indicating success or failure with optional messages.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: An Android service extending NotificationListenerService that listens for notification events, manages notification data, and performs actions like open, dismiss, or reply to notifications.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Cleans and trims notification text to a maximum length.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Serializes a notification entry into a JSON object.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.replace
methods.description: Replaces the current notification entries with a new list.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.upsert
methods.description: Updates or inserts a notification entry.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.remove
methods.description: Removes a notification entry by key.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.setConnected
methods.description: Sets the connection status of the notification listener.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.snapshot
methods.description: Produces a snapshot of current notification state.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when the notification listener is connected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when the notification listener is disconnected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.notificationChangedPayload
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload when a notification's state changes.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes the internal notification list from current system notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.toEntry
methods.description: Converts a StatusBarNotification to a DeviceNotificationEntry.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Executes a specified action (open, dismiss, reply) on a notification.
